sentences.en: We criticized the photographer for not rescuing the child first.
sentences.zh: 我们批评摄影师没有优先救助孩子。

sentences.en: It is not right to criticize people behind their backs.
sentences.zh: 背后批评别人是不对的。

sentences.en: Hinata criticized her teacher unfairly and the teacher became sick.
sentences.zh: Hinata 不公正地批评了她的老师，这让老师生病了。
